question: What will be the next homologous member of compound CH₃OH?
solution:
The correct answer is **'__C2H5____OH__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Homologue differs by **−CH₂** group.
 
• The next higher homologue of methanol is ethanol (C₂H₅OH).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homologue:** 

 
 
• The term homologue is used to describe **a compound belonging to a series of compounds differing from each other by a repeating unit,** such as a methylene group, a peptide residue, etc.
